posts.title: Per-repo Spotlight, HTML previews
posts.summary: Spotlight testing is now configured per repository instead of globally - that means you can control workspace isolation per-project. Spotlight is a useful feature for managing complex developer workflows - it allows you to run a single instance of your project and hot-swap branches, rather than running multiple branches in parallel.

posts.summary: Add a run script to create a one-click shortcut (or ⌘R) to your tests or development server.

posts.title: Performance Improvements
posts.summary: New in 0.8.3:

posts.title: Suggested Git Actions
posts.summary: Conductor now recommends each step on the way to merging your PR. Click the button in the top right to take the next action.

posts.title: Integrate with Linear, Faster Claude
posts.summary: Introducing the Dispatcher, a new way to create workspaces. You can now choose a branch name when creating a new workspaces, or create a new workspace from one of your Linear issues.

posts.title: Plan Mode
posts.summary: Plan mode (⌘P) tells the AI to make a plan before editing files.

posts.title: Add terminal context to chat
posts.summary: You can now send terminal context to chat by highlighting output and ⌘L to add it to chat.

posts.title: We no longer burn your CPU (hopefully)
posts.fullTitle: 0.7.0: We no longer burn your CPU (hopefully)
posts.summary: Before

posts.title: Bug Fixes!
posts.summary: New in 0.6.2:

posts.title: A New Look
posts.summary: We've overhauled Conductor's design. It's now sleeker, more intuitive, and feels right at home on your Mac.

posts.title: GPT-5
posts.summary: GPT-5 is live in Conductor!

posts.title: Opus 4.1
posts.summary: Claude Opus 4.1 is now available in Conductor!

posts.title: Git Diff View
posts.summary: You can now see your up-to-date git status directly in the sidebar!

posts.title: Bugfixes
posts.summary: We're experimenting with automatically collapsing Claude's responses. Long chats should also now be much more performant.

posts.title: Local Repositories + Agents
posts.summary: Conductor now supports local repositories! You can add a new repository from your local filesystem, GitHub, or any Git URL.

posts.title: Slash Commands + Custom Providers
posts.summary: Slash commands are live in Conductor! Manage your commands in Settings.

posts.title: MCPs + Message Queues
posts.summary: MCPs are live in Conductor! Add popular servers in one click from the MCP tab.

posts.title: Fine-grained GitHub permissions
posts.summary: You can now give Conductor fine-grained GitHub repository access. You can also choose to skip the GitHub integration and add repositories using your SSH/HTTPs authentication.

posts.title: Attachments
posts.summary: Conductor now supports attachments!

posts.title: GitHub Integration
posts.summary: Conductor now integrates with your GitHub account. Start working on issues in one click, and easily add your private repositories.

posts.title: Terminal Improvements
posts.summary: We've upgraded the terminal in Conductor!
